stories.title: Fed 'has some work to do on inflation,' Kansas City Fed chief says
stories.summary: The Kansas City Fed's president said the central bank still has work to do to bring inflation under control. The remark signals that at least some Fed officials see price pressures as unresolved, even as markets debate the pace of future rate moves.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed officials' comments on inflation shape expectations for rate cuts, which move bond yields and equity valuations.
whatToWatch: Further comments from other Fed officials ahead of the next policy meeting
questions: Does this view reflect a broader split among Fed officials, or is it an outlier?
How much does this shift market pricing for the next rate decision?

sources.title: Fed ’has some work to do on inflation,’ KC Fed chief says

stories.title: Houthis claim missile attack on Riyadh airport
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for a missile attack targeting the airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Details on damage, casualties, or Saudi response were not immediately available in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Attacks tied to Saudi infrastructure carry oil-market risk given Saudi Arabia's role as a top crude producer and exporter.
whatToWatch: Whether the attack disrupts airport or broader infrastructure operations
questions: What was the extent of the damage, if any?
Will this escalate broader regional tensions affecting energy supply?

stories.title: US flight disruptions stretch into third day, FAA targets Monday for normal operations
stories.summary: US flight disruptions have continued for a third straight day. The FAA has said it expects operations to return to normal by Monday.
stories.whyItMatters: Multi-day flight disruptions can weigh on airline operations and travel-linked spending, and are watched as a read on broader logistics strain.
whatToWatch: Whether flight operations normalize by Monday as the FAA expects
Any extension of delays or cancellations beyond that timeline
questions: What triggered the disruptions in the first place?
Which carriers or airports are most affected?

stories.title: Helus Pharma to present Phase 3 depression trial results Monday
stories.summary: Helus Pharma is set to present results from a Phase 3 trial in depression on Monday. No details on the trial's outcome have been disclosed yet.
stories.whyItMatters: Phase 3 readouts are binary catalysts that can sharply move a drugmaker's share price in either direction.
whatToWatch: Monday's data presentation and top-line results
questions: Will the trial meet its primary endpoint?
